requirements.text: Patients must be able to book, cancel, and reschedule their appointments online.
Patients must be able to see available time slots for GP and nurse appointments.
Patients must receive immediate confirmation notifications via email or SMS after booking an appointment.
Patients must be able to flag urgent symptoms for same-day appointments.
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online.
The system must have a dedicated section for repeat prescriptions where patients can see their current medications.
Patients must be able to specify quantities and add notes when requesting medication refills.
Patients must receive confirmation of their prescription request being processed via email or SMS.
Patients must be notified when their prescription has been approved and is ready for pickup.
There must be a dedicated section for patients to view their test results, displaying only results reviewed and authorized by a clinician.
Patients must receive notifications via email or SMS when their test results are available.
Patients must have access to actual test results along with clear explanations or summaries provided by the clinician.
The system must indicate any follow-up recommendations or appointments needed based on the test results.
The system must comply with GDPR and any applicable Irish data protection legislation.
The system must integrate seamlessly with existing practice management software without requiring full data migration.
The solution must be developed within a limited budget and prioritize essential functionalities.
The system must be intuitive enough to minimize training requirements for reception staff.
